<header><a class="brand" href="#start">P E T A L <b>/</b> L A B</a><nav><a href="#start">01 / START</a><a href="#data">02 / DATA</a><a href="#explore">03 / EXPLORE</a><a href="#learn">04 / DISCOVER</a></nav><small>26 OCTOBER 2026</small></header>
<section class="page hero" id="start"><div><div class="tag">An interactive data story / 001</div><h1>The geometry<br>of <em>a flower.</em></h1><p>Can four measurements reveal the identity of a flower? Explore 150 specimens, three species, and a surprisingly beautiful pattern hiding in plain sight.</p><a class="btn" href="#data">BEGIN THE STORY ↗</a></div><div class="bloom" aria-hidden="true"><i class="petal p1"></i><i class="petal p2"></i><i class="petal p3"></i><i class="petal p4"></i><i class="petal p5"></i><i class="dotcenter"></i></div></section>
<section class="page light" id="data"><div class="layout"><div class="tag">01 / THE SETUP</div><h2 class="heading">Nature, by the numbers.</h2><p class="sub">The Iris dataset turns petals and sepals into a question: can we recognize a flower by its geometry?</p><div class="stats"><div class="stat"><strong>150</strong><p>Individual flowers measured.</p></div><div class="stat"><strong>03</strong><p>Species: Setosa, Versicolor, Virginica.</p></div><div class="stat"><strong>04</strong><p>Measurements per flower, in cm.</p></div></div></div></section>
<section class="page" id="explore"><div class="layout"><div class="tag">02 / THE EXPLORATION</div><h2 class="heading">A pattern comes into focus.</h2><p class="sub">Every dot is a flower. Hover for measurements, change the axes and tap the species filters.</p><div class="board"><div class="toolbar"><div><div class="label">MEASUREMENT SPACE</div><div class="toggle"><button id="petal" class="active">Petal geometry</button><button id="sepal">Sepal geometry</button></div></div><div><div class="label">SPECIES / CLICK TO FILTER</div><div class="filters"><button class="chip" data-i="0"><span class="color" style="background:#e8b882"></span>Setosa</button><button class="chip" data-i="1"><span class="color" style="background:#86cdb8"></span>Versicolor</button><button class="chip" data-i="2"><span class="color" style="background:#c79de8"></span>Virginica</button></div></div></div><div id="scatter" class="chart"></div><div class="hint">TRY IT: Switch to sepal geometry and see how the three clusters overlap. &nbsp; ↗ ZOOM · HOVER · PAN</div></div></div></section>
<section class="page story" id="learn"><div class="layout"><div class="tag">03 / THE DISCOVERY</div><h2 class="heading">Petals tell the clearer story.</h2><p class="sub">A second Plotly chart: see the distribution of petal length by species.</p><div class="storygrid"><div><div class="observation"><small>OBSERVATION 01</small><h3>Setosa stands apart.</h3><p>Its short petals form a separate cluster in this sample.</p></div><div class="observation"><small>OBSERVATION 02</small><h3>Virginica stretches further.</h3><p>Its petals tend to be longest; Versicolor occupies much of the middle.</p></div><div class="observation"><small>OBSERVATION 03</small><h3>Perspective matters.</h3><p>Petal dimensions distinguish these flowers more clearly than sepal dimensions alone.</p></div></div><div class="panel"><b>PETAL LENGTH DISTRIBUTION / CM</b><div id="boxes" class="chart"></div></div></div></div></section>
<section class="page last" id="finish"><div class="tag">04 / THE TAKEAWAY</div><h2>Small details.<br><em>Big patterns.</em></h2><p>Numbers don't replace the beauty of nature. Sometimes, they give us a new way to see it.</p><a class="btn" href="#explore">REVISIT THE PLOT ↗</a><p class="source">Data: Fisher's Iris dataset (built into R as <code>iris</code>). Interactive charts made with Plotly. R Markdown presentation created <strong>26 October 2026</strong>.</p></section>

<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.35.2.min.js"></script><script>
(function(){
let species="51351402,49301402,47321302,46311502,50361402,54391704,46341403,50341502,44291402,49311501,54371502,48341602,48301401,43301101,58401202,57441504,54391304,51351403,57381703,51381503,54341702,51371504,46361002,51331705,48341902,50301602,50341604,52351502,52341402,47321602,48311602,54341504,52411501,55421402,49311502,50321202,55351302,49361401,44301302,51341502,50351303,45231303,44321302,50351606,51381904,48301403,51381602,46321402,53371502,50331402|70324714,64324515,69314915,55234013,65284615,57284513,63334716,49243310,66294613,52273914,50203510,59304215,60224010,61294714,56293613,67314414,56304515,58274110,62224515,56253911,59324818,61284013,63254915,61284712,64294313,66304414,68284814,67305017,60294515,57263510,55243811,55243710,58273912,60275116,54304515,60344516,67314715,63234413,56304113,55254013,55264412,61304614,58264012,50233310,56274213,57304212,57294213,62294313,51253011,57284113|63336025,58275119,71305921,63295618,65305822,76306621,49254517,73296318,67255818,72366125,65325120,64275319,68305521,57255020,58285124,64325323,65305518,77386722,77266923,60225015,69325723,56284920,77286720,63274918,67335721,72326018,62284818,61304918,64285621,72305816,74286119,79386420,64285622,63285115,61265614,77306123,63345624,64315518,60304818,69315421,67315624,69315123,58275119,68325923,67335725,67305223,63255019,65305220,62345423,59305118".split('|').map((g,i)=>g.split(',').map((s,j)=>({id:i*50+j+1,p:[0,2,4,6].map(k=>Number(s.slice(k,k+2))/10)})));
const names=['Setosa','Versicolor','Virginica'],colors=['#e8b882','#86cdb8','#c79de8'];
let which='petal',on=[true,true,true];
const layout={paper_bgcolor:'rgba(0,0,0,0)',plot_bgcolor:'rgba(0,0,0,0)',font:{family:'DM Sans,Arial',color:'#b2c7b9'},margin:{l:62,r:22,t:25,b:64},showlegend:false};
const axis=t=>({title:{text:t,standoff:12},gridcolor:'#ffffff19',zeroline:false});
function scatter(){
let ix=which==='petal'?2:0,iy=which==='petal'?3:1;
let traces=species.map((g,i)=>({type:'scatter',mode:'markers',name:names[i],visible:on[i]?true:'legendonly',x:g.map(v=>v.p[ix]),y:g.map(v=>v.p[iy]),marker:{color:colors[i],size:10,opacity:.9,line:{color:'#14252b',width:1}},customdata:g.map(v=>[v.id,v.p[0],v.p[1],v.p[2],v.p[3]]),hovertemplate:'<b>'+names[i]+'</b> #'+ '%{customdata[0]}' +'<br>Sepal: %{customdata[1]} × %{customdata[2]} cm<br>Petal: %{customdata[3]} × %{customdata[4]} cm<extra></extra>'}));
Plotly.react('scatter',traces,{...layout,xaxis:axis(which==='petal'?'Petal length (cm)':'Sepal length (cm)'),yaxis:axis(which==='petal'?'Petal width (cm)':'Sepal width (cm)')},{responsive:true,displaylogo:false});
}
function boxes(){Plotly.newPlot('boxes',species.map((g,i)=>({type:'box',name:names[i],y:g.map(v=>v.p[2]),line:{color:colors[i]},fillcolor:colors[i]+'33',marker:{color:colors[i]},boxpoints:'all',jitter:.26,pointpos:0,hovertemplate:names[i]+'<br>Petal length: %{y} cm<extra></extra>'})),{...layout,xaxis:axis('Species'),yaxis:axis('Petal length (cm)')},{responsive:true,displaylogo:false});}
function change(m){which=m;document.getElementById('petal').classList.toggle('active',m==='petal');document.getElementById('sepal').classList.toggle('active',m==='sepal');scatter()}
function init(){if(!window.Plotly){document.getElementById('scatter').innerHTML='<p>Plotly needs an internet connection to load.</p>';return}scatter();boxes();document.getElementById('petal').onclick=()=>change('petal');document.getElementById('sepal').onclick=()=>change('sepal');document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let i=+b.dataset.i;on[i]=!on[i];b.classList.toggle('off',!on[i]);scatter()})}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);else init();
})();</script>
